verdict.rationale: Blaxel's own docs describe sandbox images (templates) built from Dockerfiles with pre-configured tools, languages and frameworks, from which new sandboxes deploy in seconds. That covers both custom templates and Dockerfile-defined container environments. missing for 10: explicit documentation of importing an existing prebuilt image from an external registry, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can define custom sandbox templates or bring my own container image

citations.quote: Create reusable sandbox images with pre-configured tools, languages, and frameworks using Dockerfiles. Deploy new sandboxes from images in seconds.
Sandbox images allow you to create customized & reusable sandbox environments.
